verdict.rationale: The evidence only thinly implies an employee-facing portal: a 'shareholder dashboards' page says 'Invite your team.', and option recipients submit exercise requests through Vestd themselves. It does not document what employees see. Missing for 10: documented display of individual grants, vesting progress/schedule, strike price, exit/outcome scenario modeling of equity value, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I get my own portal showing my grants, vesting progress, strike price, and what my equity could be worth under different outcomes

citations.quote: When a recipient is ready to exercise their options, they submit a request through Vestd.
